iterations.plan: Compute Hangul syllable decomposition using Unicode tables and map to compatibility jamo.
iterations.code:
# solution.py
def decompose(text: str) -> str:
    """
    Replace precomposed Hangul syllables with their constituent
    compatibility jamo characters.  Characters that are not
    precomposed Hangul syllables are left unchanged.
    """
    # Unicode constants for Hangul
    HANGUL_S_BASE = 0xAC00
    HANGUL_S_END = 0xD7A3
    L_COUNT = 19
    V_COUNT = 21
    T_COUNT = 28
    N_COUNT = V_COUNT * T_COUNT  # 588

    # Compatibility Jamo lists
    L_TABLE = [
        "ㄱ", "ㄲ", "ㄴ", "ㄷ", "ㄸ", "ㄹ", "ㅁ", "ㅂ", "ㅃ", "ㅅ",
        "ㅆ", "ㅇ", "ㅈ", "ㅉ", "ㅊ", "ㅋ", "ㅌ", "ㅍ", "ㅎ"
    ]
    V_TABLE = [
        "ㅏ", "ㅐ", "ㅑ", "ㅒ", "ㅓ", "ㅔ", "ㅕ", "ㅖ", "ㅗ", "ㅘ",
        "ㅙ", "ㅚ", "ㅛ", "ㅜ", "ㅝ", "ㅞ", "ㅟ", "ㅠ", "ㅡ", "ㅢ",
        "ㅣ"
    ]
    T_TABLE = [
        "", "ㄱ", "ㄲ", "ㄳ", "ㄴ", "ㄵ", "ㄶ", "ㄷ", "ㄹ", "ㄺ",
        "ㄻ", "ㄼ", "ㄽ", "ㄾ", "ㄿ", "ㅀ", "ㅁ", "ㅂ", "ㅄ", "ㅅ",
        "ㅆ", "ㅇ", "ㅈ", "ㅊ", "ㅋ", "ㅌ", "ㅍ", "ㅎ"
    ]

    result = []

    for ch in text:
        code = ord(ch)
        if HANGUL_S_BASE <= code <= HANGUL_S_END:
            s_index = code - HANGUL_S_BASE
            l_index = s_index // N_COUNT
            v_index = (s_index % N_COUNT) // T_COUNT
            t_index = s_index % T_COUNT

            result.append(L_TABLE[l_index])
            result.append(V_TABLE[v_index])
            if t_index != 0:
                result.append(T_TABLE[t_index])
        else:
            result.append(ch)

    return "".join(result)
